name: authlint
description: Paste anything from a login flow, a JWT, a SAML response, a discovery document, a JWKS or an authorization URL, and see what is wrong with it. One HTML file, nothing leaves the browser.

scripts.check: node build.js && node --test test/*.test.js && node scripts/verify-dist.js && node scripts/verify-security.js

comment: The devDependency is for the test harness only: Node has no DOMParser, and the SAML checks need one. Nothing ships in dist/index.html except the files in src/.
